## Question

<div class="chapter-question">If an LLM-assisted result changes, which parts of the discrepancy can we explain from the saved record?</div>

## Why this week belongs here

This second research-agent session turns to replication, provider dependence and the practical record needed to understand a rerun. It remains low-stakes because of the holiday week.

## Provisional core readings

- Barrie et al. (2026), §10.7. [Download chapter PDF](../downloads/readings/ai-and-research-methods-barrie-et-al-2026.pdf). [@BarrieEtAl2026AIResearchMethods]
- Feuerriegel et al. (2026), reporting checklist. [@FeuerriegelEtAl2026]
- Barrie, Palmer and Spirling (2025), “Replication for Language Models.” [@BarriePalmerSpirling2025]
- Further multi-agent context: *Nature Machine Intelligence* (2026). [@NatureMITransparency2026]

## Planned chapter and class arc

Distinguish repeatability, robustness and replication; use the reporting checklist on a real workflow; compare original and rerun configurations; connect discrepancies to the final-project reproducibility record.

[See the provisional Week 12 Python plan](../python/session12.qmd).
